description_en: Adds a DNAT entry by calling CreateForwardEntry
name: CreateForwardEntry

parameters.help_en: The ID of the NAT gateway
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The Elastic IP Address (EIP) that provides public network access.

The EIP must not be occupied by an SNAT rule of the same NAT gateway. You can check the IpLists.UsingStatus field returned by DescribeNatGateways to confirm that the EIP is in the Idle state
parameters.help_zh:
提供公网访问的弹性公网IP地址。

该 EIP 不得被同一 NAT 网关的 SNAT 规则占用；可通过 DescribeNatGateways 返回的 IpLists.UsingStatus 确认其为 Idle 状态
parameters.name: external_ip

parameters.help_en:
The external port or port range for port forwarding.
The port range must be within 1 to 65535.
To forward traffic within a port range, separate the start and end ports with a forward slash (/), such as 10/20.
If ExternalPort is set to a port range, InternalPort must also be set to a port range with the same number of ports. For example, if ExternalPort is set to 10/20, InternalPort must be set to 80/90
parameters.help_zh:
需要进行端口转发的外部端口或端口段。
输入的端口范围需要在1~65535之间。
如果需要在端口段内转发，请在输入时以正斜线（/）隔开起始端口，例如10/20。
如果ExternalPort设置为端口段，则InternalPort也需要设置为端口段，且端口段的端口个数相同，例如ExternalPort设置为10/20，InternalPort设置为80/90
parameters.name: external_port

parameters.help_en: The private IP address of the instance that communicates with the Internet through the DNAT entry
parameters.help_zh: 通过DNAT条目进行公网通信的实例的私网IP地址
parameters.name: internal_ip

parameters.help_en:
The internal port or port range for port forwarding.

The port range must be within 1 to 65535.
To forward traffic within a port range, separate the start and end ports with a forward slash (/), such as 10/20
parameters.help_zh:
进行端口转发的内部端口或端口段。

输入的端口范围需要在1~65535之间。
如果需要在端口段内转发，请在输入时以正斜线（/）隔开起始端口，例如10/20
parameters.name: internal_port

parameters.help_en: The name of the DNAT rule. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh: DNAT规则的名称。长度为2~128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: forward_entry_name

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type. Valid values: 

TCP: forwards TCP packets.   

UDP: forwards UDP packets.   

Any (default): forwards all packets
parameters.help_zh:
协议类型，取值： 

TCP：转发TCP协议的报文。   

UDP：转发UDP协议的报文。   

Any（默认）：转发所有协议的报文
parameters.name: ip_protocol

parameters.help_en: The health check port for DNAT. The port must be within the internal port range. Default value: empty
parameters.help_zh: DNAT的探测端口，需要在内网端口范围内。默认值为空
parameters.name: health_check_port

parameters.help_en: The standby EIP that provides public network access. The standby EIP must be bound to the NAT gateway. After the DNAT entry is created, the standby EIP takes effect
parameters.help_zh: 提供公网访问的备用弹性公网IP地址，需要选择绑定在NAT上的备用弹性IP。DNAT创建成功后，备用公网IP会生效
parameters.name: standby_external_ip

ForwardEntryId.description_en: The ID of the DNAT entry
